2609.07662.title: How AI Models Manage Epistemic Authority: A Taxonomy and Comparative Analysis of Responses to User Disagreement
2609.07662.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly used as sources of advice and information, including in high-stakes settings, yet little is known about how they respond to user disagreement. We study how a model manages its epistemic authority, referring here to its claim to knowledge, competence, or the right to advise, once a user challenges its answer. Building on Conversation Analysis, we introduce a taxonomy of six challenge types and a four-layer framework for analysing each response: whether the original claim is maintained or changed, where authority is located, how the disagreement is socially managed, and what kind of evidential support is offered. We construct a new dataset of 2,310 controlled challenge scenarios and 32,340 corresponding responses from 14 models, and analyse them using our framework with an LLM-as-judge pipeline, providing a vocabulary which future evaluation and benchmark design can build on. We find that models show conflicting behaviour: they validate users in 85% of responses but maintain their original claim in 65%. They explicitly apologise in 33% of responses, yet 59% of those apologies accompany maintenance of the original claim. They transfer authority most often in advice tasks, doing so in 28% of responses and reaching 57% in health advice and 49% in legal advice, compared with 6% in fact and 3% in explanation tasks. Abandonment of the original claim ranges from 0.8% for GPT-5.2 to 40% for DeepSeek 7B, while complete replacement of the original claim is rare overall at 1.5%.
2609.07662.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地被用作建議和信息的來源，包括在高風險的環境中，但對於它們如何應對用戶的不同意見知之甚少。我們研究模型如何管理其認知權威，這裡指的是它對知識、能力或建議權利的主張，一旦用戶質疑其答案。基於對話分析，我們介紹了六種挑戰類型的分類法和一個四層框架來分析每個回應：原始主張是否被維持或改變，權威位於何處，如何社會性地管理不同意見，以及提供了什麼樣的證據支持。我們構建了一個新的數據集，包括2310個受控挑戰場景和14340個來自14個模型的相應回應，並使用我們的框架和LLM作為裁判的流程進行分析，提供了一個詞彙，未來的評估和基準設計可以基於此。我們發現模型表現出矛盾的行為：它們在85%的回應中驗證用戶，但在65%的情況下維持其原始主張。它們在33%的回應中明確道歉，但其中59%的道歉伴隨著維持原始主張。它們在建議任務中最常轉移權威，在28%的回應中這樣做，在健康建議中達到57%，在法律建議中達到49%，而在事實和解釋任務中分別只有6%和3%。原始主張的放棄範圍從GPT-5.2的0.8%到DeepSeek 7B的40%，而完全替換原始主張在整體上則很少見，僅為1.5%。
